title: Concept: Gemfile loads a gemspec from a build-machine path
description: Gemfile declares a `gemspec` directive that points at a path rather than a gemspec name, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The dependency set of the build is decided by a file outside the repository's review, so the resolved gems are unknown.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Gemfile (rubygems).
risk: The dependency set of the build is decided by a file outside the repository's review, so the resolved gems are unknown.
